label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.4… supports At the selected world every existent is in…
note: Q.4 a.1 ad 3 calls esse 'actualitas omnium rerum'; the claim formalizes only the direction from act to esse. The premise uses the other direction, from existence at the selected world to act in some respect; reading the Ontic existence assignment as esse in re is the analyst's.
